office_does: A King County District Court judge hears misdemeanor criminal cases, small claims, traffic cases, and protection orders, and is elected by voters in the electoral district to a four-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Tricia Grove Johnson is the only candidate for this position; the pamphlet names no incumbent, so the seat appears to be open.

candidates.summary: Judge pro tem and Maple Valley prosecuting attorney with prior criminal defense and public defense work, running for a seat for which the pamphlet names no incumbent.
highlights: Judge pro tem and Maple Valley Prosecuting Attorney [S1]
Reports 30 years across prosecution, criminal defense, and public defense [S1]
Self-reports "Exceptionally Well Qualified" ratings from five bar associations [S1]
